input_fields.name: executed_script_artifact
input_fields.description: Observed actual script path/bytes or authoritative loaded-artifact reference.

input_fields.name: version_metadata
input_fields.description: API/package/version metadata associated with the run.

input_fields.name: execution_event
input_fields.description: Run identifier and event to bind to the artifact.

result_fields.name: executed_artifact_identity
result_fields.description: Actual path, SHA-256, version metadata, run ID, and binding evidence.

result_fields.name: identity_status
result_fields.description: One of bound, mismatch, unavailable, or needs_manual_review.

procedure: Read/hash the actual artifact and collect version metadata without substituting planned source.
Join artifact identity to exactly one execution event and compare operation/version fields.
Return the identity and status; preserve mismatch as unresolved.
Do not edit the script or rerun while recording identity.
rejection_rules: Reject missing actual artifact, report-only identity, or multiple candidate scripts.
Do not use an output report alone as proof of executed identity.
